headline: Open-source LLM stock analysis with scheduled runs

appearances.newly_possible: Anyone can run an LLM stock analysis system that pulls market data and news, shows a dashboard and sends alerts on a free schedule.

appearances.limits: Stars do not show the analysis is accurate.

appearances.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
appearances.summary: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
